consent.body: By sending this application you entrust Dina Kenitra FC with personal data (identity, contact, CV). Under Morocco's Law 09-08 on personal data protection, they are collected to assess your application, kept for 6 months (unsuccessful applications) and accessible only to the club's sports staff. You have a right of access, rectification, opposition and deletion that you can exercise at any time via
consent.checkbox_body: that Dina Kenitra FC processes my personal data for the purposes and conditions described above.
consent.minor_body: Since you are under 18, the law requires the consent of a parent or legal guardian. By checking the box below you confirm that this consent has been obtained.

manage.title: My application
manage.subtitle: Review the data Dina Kenitra FC holds about you, or exercise your right to deletion at any time.
manage.rights_intro: Under Morocco's Law 09-08 on personal data protection, you can at any time:
manage.rights_withdraw: Withdraw your consent and permanently delete your application (button below).
manage.rights_consult: Consult this page at any time via your personal link.
manage.danger_body: Your application, your CV and all associated information will be permanently erased from our servers. This action is irreversible.
manage.confirm_body: Your data (name, contact, CV, message) will be permanently erased. Our staff will no longer be able to review your application. Confirm?
manage.flash_deleted: Your data has been permanently deleted. Thank you.

deletion_request.title: Find my file
deletion_request.subtitle: Enter the email used when applying. If a file exists, we send you your personal link to view or delete it.
deletion_request.privacy_note: For your security, we never confirm whether an address is or is not in our database. If a file exists, the email arrives within a few minutes.
